intent.audience: IG followers of the story carousels (Thai, phone)
intent.message: Two friends find a baby bird that fell from its nest.
intent.story_context: ลูกนกตกรัง, slide 1 of 5 (carousel/kits/2026-11-24_81-baby-bird)
intent.scene_objective: the viewer must SEE the baby bird and the two friends' concern

primary_focal_point.what: the baby bird on the ground
primary_focal_point.where: should be between the two figures, near the crouching friend's hands

blueprint.negative_space: top third holds the two speech bubbles

critique.problem: the baby bird — the subject of the line 'มีลูกนกตกอยู่ตรงนี้' — is tiny, low-contrast and outside the saliency top 3; attention goes to the speech bubbles (0.72, 0.68) and the tree trunk
critique.likely_cause: bird generated small at the frame edge; tree trunk is the darkest, sharpest vertical in the centre
critique.fix: regenerate with the bird larger in the centre-bottom between the figures, or composite a bird layer near the crouching friend's hands; lighten the trunk
critique.side_effects: changes the slide-to-slide continuity — check slides 2–5

critique.problem: the trunk splits the frame exactly in half, separating the two friends who should be sharing one concern
critique.fix: shift the trunk to a third or behind one figure; or keep it if separation is meant (it is not in this beat)
critique.side_effects: bubble positions may need to move

critique.problem: hands rest on the knees instead of reaching toward the bird, so the action that links character and subject is missing
critique.fix: pose 'one hand reaching gently toward the small bird on the ground'
critique.side_effects: hands are a known weak point — check fingers

critique.problem: none — Thai text is in the HTML layer, high contrast, correct spelling

score.rater: claude (provisional AI judgement, no viewer test)
